title: Shipping options for an order
audioScript:
Hi, this is Carlos from Redline Online Store. You placed an order yesterday for a standing desk, and I'm calling to confirm your shipping option. Because the desk is large, standard shipping isn't available. You'll need to choose between two methods, and I'm afraid the cheapest one will take about ten days.
If you need it sooner, because you mentioned your office opens next week, I'd recommend the express option, which is guaranteed within four days. Please call me back or reply to the e-mail I sent to let me know which one you prefer, and we'll ship the desk immediately.

questions.questionText: Why is the speaker calling?
questions.explanation: He says he is calling to confirm the shipping option.

questions.questionText: Look at the graphic. How much will the listener probably pay for shipping?
questions.explanation: The listener needs the desk before next week, so the express option at $120 fits.

questions.questionText: What does the speaker ask the listener to do?
questions.explanation: He asks the listener to call back or reply to the e-mail with a preference.

title: Quarterly budget by department
audioScript:
Thank you for joining the budget review. As you can see in the chart, we've spent most of our funds on equipment this quarter. Marketing spending was lower than planned, mainly because the television campaign was postponed until next quarter.
Training costs were higher than expected, but I think it was worth it because the new software is already saving time. Next quarter, I'd like to shift some funds from travel to technical support, since our team is traveling less. Please send me your proposals by Friday.

questions.questionText: What does the speaker say about marketing spending?
questions.explanation: She says marketing spending was lower because the television campaign was postponed.

questions.questionText: Look at the graphic. Which category had the largest increase over its planned amount?
questions.explanation: Training was planned at 30 and came in at 41, which is the only category above its plan.

questions.questionText: What does the speaker ask the listeners to do?
questions.explanation: She asks them to send her their proposals by Friday.
